  html_document: default

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
pacman::p_load(cmdstanr, tidyverse, here, ggplot2, future, future.apply)
```


## simulate 1 dataset 
```{r}
N = 34

mean = rnorm(1, 40, 6)
sigma = rexp(1, rate = 1)

beta_int = rnorm(1,0,15)
beta_env = rnorm(1,0,15)
beta_t = rnorm(1,0,15)

treatment = sample(c(rep(0, 17), rep(1, 17)))
env = sample(c(rep(0, 17), rep(1, 17)))

mu = mean + beta_env*env + beta_t*treatment + beta_int*(treatment*env)
y = rnorm(N, mu, sigma)

sim = c(NA, mean, beta_int, beta_env, beta_t, sigma)


```


## Fit 1 dataset
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
data_stan = list(N = N, y = y, treatment = treatment, environment=env)

model = cmdstan_model(here("Data Analysis", "Analysis tests", "two_way_ANOVA.stan"))

fit = model$sample(data = data_stan, iter_warmup =1000, iter_sampling = 2000, chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4)
```
## evaluate fit
```{r}
summary = fit$summary()
summary$sim = sim

summary


```






## Generate multiple data sets
```{r}
sim = 200

sim_list = list()

for(i in 1:sim){
  
  N = 34

  mean = rnorm(1, 40, 6)
  sigma = rexp(1, rate = 1)

  beta_int = rnorm(1,0,7)
  beta_env = rnorm(1,0,7)
  beta_t = rnorm(1,0,7)

  treatment = sample(c(rep(0, 17), rep(1, 17)))
  env = sample(c(rep(0, 17), rep(1, 17)))

  mu = mean + beta_env*env + beta_t*treatment + beta_int*(treatment*env)
  y = rnorm(N, mu, sigma)
  
  sim_data = data.frame(treatment = treatment, env = env, y = y, mean = mean, 
                        beta_int = beta_int, beta_env = beta_env, beta_t = beta_t, sigma = sigma)
  
  sim_list[[i]] = sim_data
  
}

```


## Fit model sim times
```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
n_cores = availableCores()
use_cores = max(1, n_cores - 4)

plan(multisession, workers = use_cores)

model = cmdstan_model(here("Data Analysis", "Analysis tests", "two_way_ANOVA.stan"))

fits = future_lapply(seq_len(sim), function(i) {
  df = sim_list[[i]]
  
  data_stan <- list(N = 34,y = df$y,treatment = df$treatment,environment = df$env)
  
  fit <- model$sample(data = data_stan,iter_warmup = 1000,iter_sampling = 2000,chains = 4,parallel_chains = 4,refresh = 0)
  
  summary <- fit$summary()
  
  param_l <- with(df, c(NA,mean[1],beta_int[1],beta_env[1],beta_t[1],sigma[1]))
  
  summary$sim <- param_l
  summary})
```


## check parameter recovery
```{r}
result <- bind_rows(fits, .id = "sim_id")

result %>% 
  filter(variable == "mu") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(x = sim, y = mean, ymin = q5, ymax = q95))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1)+
  theme_classic()

result %>% 
  filter(variable == "beta_int") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(x = sim, y = mean, ymin = q5, ymax = q95))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1)+
  theme_classic()

result %>% 
  filter(variable == "beta_env") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(x = sim, y = mean, ymin = q5, ymax = q95))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1)+
  theme_classic()

result %>% 
  filter(variable == "beta_t") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(x = sim, y = mean, ymin = q5, ymax = q95))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1)+
  theme_classic()

result %>% 
  filter(variable == "sigma") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_pointrange(aes(x = sim, y = mean, ymin = q5, ymax = q95))+
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1)+
  theme_classic()
```
